breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the original inconsistent values (W1=150 m/s, beta1=45°, W2=100 m/s, beta2=30°) alongside the constant axial velocity assumption without recognizing or resolving the contradiction. The ground truth fixes this by recalculating W2 = Va/cos(beta2) ≈ 122.5 m/s to enforce consistent axial velocity. The agent instead introduced an unrelated zero-inlet-whirl assumption and never addressed the fundamental inconsistency in the axial velocity components.
